title: Lawn blessing
hook: **WIP:** a real lawn run charges stronger **soul** earn on the next stretch of web expeditions — lawn makes idle better. Not finished yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Not finished. You should not expect a reliable blessing charge meter as a daily loop yet.
A temporary boost to soul earn on following web expeditions after a real lawn run — not a permanent stat and not a second stock.
Design intent: lawn improves the next idle waves. It must never be the only way to keep up.
What blessing must not become. Souls already pay from play without it.
The idle dispatch loop that collects later — see [expeditions](expeditions).

alsoTrue: Capture and trophies are sibling WIP lawn outcomes — [capture](capture) · [lawn trophies](lawn-trophies).
Play lawn for souls and deploy today; treat missing blessing UI as unfinished work.

sections.title: Not finished yet
paras: Fantasy: finish a strong match, then collect better from the next idle waves.
Until it ships, ordinary lawn soul earn and expedition returns still work.

sections.title: Design intent
sections.intro: How it is meant to hang on the loops:

cards.name: Charge
cards.body: A real lawn run builds blessing for what comes next.

cards.name: Spend on idle
cards.body: The next stretch of web expeditions earns souls more strongly.

cards.name: Not a gate
cards.body: Unlocked web play must remain viable without endless lawn.

diagram: +->  next web expeditions  ->  stronger soul earn

sections.title: What you do today
paras: Play lawn matches and collect expeditions normally.
Do not plan your whole economy around a blessing button that is not live yet.

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP
doSteps: Earn souls from lawn and expeditions as they already ship.
When blessing UI appears, finish a real match first, then collect the boosted idle stretch.
If idle ever feels mandatory-only-via-lawn, that is a design bug — report the feel, do not invent a private workaround economy.

mixUps.a: WIP — not finished. Absence is expected.
No. Design is stronger soul earn on following expeditions — not a combat buff.

mixUps.q: Must I lawn forever to keep up?
mixUps.a: No. Design says a strong run can bless idle — never be the only way to keep up.

mixUps.q: Is this the same as trophies?
mixUps.a: No. Trophies are cosmetic prestige. Blessing is temporary idle soul pressure.

mixUps.q: Do I still get souls without blessing?
mixUps.a: Yes. Lawn and other faucets already pay.
